name: hyper-realistic-choco-dress-selfie
image_purpose: Fashion outfit post and interior lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a raw high-fidelity vertical bathroom mirror selfie with warm indoor color and sharp material detail.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman matching the required face and hair reference, wearing a chocolate-brown long-sleeve fitted mini dress with realistic fabric tension and natural fit. She stands holding an orange smartphone, with her face partially obscured by the mirror-selfie composition and a calm direct gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 mirror-selfie framing, subject centered from head to upper thighs, accurate reflection, olive-green paneled walls, ornate floral framed artwork above, gold faucet, and patterned copper-toned bowl in the foreground.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm indoor ambient light around 3000K, soft natural shadows on the dress and walls, realistic bathroom reflections, moody polished domestic atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 17 Pro simulation, 24mm, f/5.6, sharp focus, visible digital grain, realistic skin pores, hair, fabric, paneled-wall, brass and copper texture, no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A raw high-fidelity 9:16 bathroom mirror selfie of one approved adult woman matching the required face and hair reference. She wears a chocolate-brown long-sleeve fitted mini dress with realistic fabric texture and natural fit, holding an orange smartphone so the mirror composition partially obscures her face while preserving a calm direct gaze. Include olive-green paneled walls, ornate floral framed artwork, a gold faucet, and a patterned copper-toned bowl in the foreground. Warm 3000K indoor ambient light, soft shadows, accurate mirror reflection, iPhone 17 Pro 24mm look at f/5.6, sharp material detail, visible digital grain, and moody polished lifestyle realism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, explicit body-part emphasis, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, broken reflection, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
